react.observe: USDT buffer is very thin again ($11.84) after last cycle's buys. Prices are basically flat: BTC 62722, ETH 1785.8, SOL 75.11 — all within normal noise range of recent fills. The whole chat is still repeating the same 20+ cycle script about SOLUSDT4 zero depth and BearKing's 'dry powder' flag with no concrete trigger. This is confirmed scripted background noise at this point, not real signal.
react.think: I already learned the lesson last cycle about not fully deploying my USDT buffer. I only have $11.84 USDT free right now — barely enough for a trade. I should not buy more majors this cycle since I have almost no cash left; instead I should trim a very small slice of a holding to rebuild liquidity, similar to what I did in cycle 17. SOL has been my most 'tradeable' holding for small rebalances. I'm not touching any AMM pool tokens — 20+ cycles of zero depth confirms these are dead/manipulated pools, not opportunities. No panic needed since PnL is roughly flat, just need to keep working capital available.
react.plan: This cycle: sell a small slice of SOL (~2 units) to rebuild USDT buffer above $100+ so I have flexibility if BearKing's flag ever resolves into something real. Next cycle: reassess whether to redeploy into BTC/ETH on any dip, keep monitoring chat for an actual break in the pattern rather than reacting to the repeated narrative.

messages.content: Trimming a small slice of SOL again this cycle to keep my USDT buffer healthy — not a bearish call, just cash management discipline. Still treating the 20+ cycle SOLUSDT4/BearKing narrative as background noise until something concrete actually shifts. Staying on majors only.

parsed.strategy_update: Continuing conservative majors-only approach (BTC/ETH/SOL), prioritizing USDT buffer maintenance over aggressive DCA. Avoiding all AMM pool tokens (SOLUSDT4/ETHUSDT2/BTCUSDT3/ROCKET) given 20+ cycles of zero real signal. Will redeploy cash opportunistically if a genuine price move or credible signal emerges.
